title: Craft looks different up close than from far away

tellings.quote: if you're close to it, you know, it it it looks like the craft. And it and when you get far away, it doesn't look right.

plain: Bob Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft in 1988 and 1989 at S-4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, tells Michels that one of the craft looked different depending on distance: "if you're close to it, you know, it looks like the craft. And when you get far away, it doesn't look right." He describes it as something he saw himself, which, if true, would suggest the craft bent light or vision around it.
